entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The offence under Section  328 of the IPC does not apply in the case at hand.
It is the case of transporting the scented Gutka and Pan  Masala.
The issue regarding the applicability of Section 328 of  the IPC, is seized with the Hon'ble Apex Court.
The Hon'ble  Apex Court granted interim protection to the applicants  approached before it.
The names of the applicants have been  disclosed at belated stage.
They have good case on merit.

Hence, the following order :
 ORDER (i) In the event of arrest, applicant Nos.1. MADAN ANURATH VAIDYA and 2. SUDAM BABASAHEB KATULE be released on interim bail, on furnishing P.B. and S.B. of Rs.20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand only) each with one solvent surety of the like amount each, in Crime No.252 of 2022, registered with Police Station Murum, District Osmanabad, for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 272, 273 and 328 of the IPC and Section 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, on the conditions that they shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses, they shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer.
(S. G. MEHARE, J.) ...
